<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">What is VC Client</h1><a id="user-content-what-is-vc-client" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: What is VC Client" href="#what-is-vc-client"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>This is a client software for performing real-time voice conversion using various Voice Conversion (VC) AI. The supported AI for voice conversion are as follows.</li>
</ol>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><a href="https://github.com/isletennos/MMVC_Trainer">MMVC</a> (only v1)</li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/svc-develop-team/so-vits-svc">so-vits-svc</a> (only v1)</li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/liujing04/Retrieval-based-Voice-Conversion-WebUI">RVC(Retrieval-based-Voice-Conversion)</a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/yxlllc/DDSP-SVC">DDSP-SVC</a> (only v1)</li>
<li><a href="https://prj-beatrice.com/" rel="nofollow">Beatrice JVS Corpus Edition</a> * experimental,  (<em><strong>NOT MIT License</strong></em> see <a href="https://github.com/w-okada/voice-changer/blob/master/server/voice_changer/Beatrice/">readme</a>) *  Only for Windows, CPU dependent (only v1)
<ul dir="auto">
<li><a href="https://prj-beatrice.com/" rel="nofollow">Beatrice v2</a> (only for v2)</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>Distribute the load by running Voice Changer on a different PC
The real-time voice changer of this application works on a server-client configuration. By running the MMVC server on a separate PC, you can run it while minimizing the impact on other resource-intensive processes such as gaming commentary.</li>
</ol>
<p dir="auto"><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/48346627/206640768-53f6052d-0a96-403b-a06c-6714a0b7471d.png"><img src="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/48346627/206640768-53f6052d-0a96-403b-a06c-6714a0b7471d.png" alt="image" style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>
<ol start="3" dir="auto">
<li>Cross-platform compatibility
Supports Windows, Mac (including Apple Silicon M1), Linux, and Google Colaboratory.</li>
</ol>

<p dir="auto">This is an app for performing voice changes with MMVC and so-vits-svc.</p>
<p dir="auto">It can be used in two main ways, in order of difficulty:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Using a pre-built binary</li>
<li>Setting up an environment with Docker or Anaconda and using it</li>
</ul>

<p dir="auto">v2 for Windows</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Please download and use <code>vcclient_win_std_xxx.zip</code>. You can perform voice conversion using a reasonably high-performance CPU without a GPU, or by utilizing DirectML to leverage GPUs (AMD, Nvidia). v2 supports both torch and onnx.</li>

</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">v2 for Mac (Apple Silicon)</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Please download and use <code>vcclient_mac_xxx.zip</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">v1</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>If you are using a Windows and Nvidia GPU, please download ONNX (cpu, cuda), PyTorch (cpu, cuda).</li>
<li>If you are using a Windows and AMD/Intel GPU, please download ONNX (cpu, DirectML) and PyTorch (cpu, cuda). AMD/Intel GPUs are only enabled for ONNX models.</li>
<li>In either case, for GPU support, PyTorch and Onnxruntime are only enabled if supported.</li>
<li>If you are not using a GPU on Windows, please download ONNX (cpu, cuda) and PyTorch (cpu, cuda).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">For Windows user, after unzipping the downloaded zip file, please run the <code>start_http.bat</code> file corresponding to your VC.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">For Mac version, after unzipping the downloaded file, double-click the <code>startHttp.command</code> file corresponding to your VC. If a message indicating that the developer cannot be verified is displayed, please press the control key and click to run it again (or right-click to run it).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">If you are connecting remotely, please use the <code>.command</code> file (Mac) or <code>.bat</code> file (Windows) with https instead of http.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">The encoder of DDPS-SVC only supports hubert-soft.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto"><a href="https://huggingface.co/wok000/vcclient000/tree/main" rel="nofollow">Download from hugging face</a></p>
</li>
</ul>

<p dir="auto">Clone this repository and use it. Setting up WSL2 is essential for Windows. Additionally, setting up virtual environments such as Docker or Anaconda on WSL2 is also required. On Mac, setting up Python virtual environments such as Anaconda is necessary. Although preparation is required, this method works the fastest in many environments. <strong> Even without a GPU, it may work well enough with a reasonably new CPU (refer to the section on real-time performance below)</strong>.</p>
